name: ElectricalTakeoffSoftware.com
summary: A cloud takeoff editor with AI symbol detection, priced per project.
differentiator: The lowest published takeoff price here, charged per project instead of per user. It is a takeoff editor that exports estimates, not an estimating database.
pricing: $7 per project. 30-day free trial, no credit card.

scope.takeoff: AI symbol detection on vector PDFs. You review markers, place your own and export estimates.
scope.library: Not stated on the pages we read.
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: Not stated on the pages we read.

bestFor: Small shops that bid a few jobs a month and want to pay per project.
skipIf: You want a priced material database and labor units.
watchOut: The AI detection is described for vector PDFs. The review editor is said to work on scanned plans too.
